Team —

Kickoff note for Q3 OKR sign-off and QBR packet prep. High-level asks:

- Owners confirmed on the attached OKR matrix (see column G for owner names).
- Audit readiness: attach checklist that KJ Consulting will use during the pre-audit review. We need evidence owners to confirm data sources and retention policies.
- Handoff: Rishi, please consolidate owner responses and surface any metric that needs alternate measurement (e.g., replaced p99 latency metric).

Timeline: please get owner confirmations in this thread by EOD 2028-06-14. I will compile the exec slide packet on 6/15 morning.

Attachments: Q3_okr_matrix.xlsx, Audit-Readiness-Checklist.pdf

Quick asks:
1) Rishi — compile a one-line acceptance per owner (owner + committed metric + known risk).
2) Laura — confirm the QBR narrative arc (2 slides) and where to include audit notes.
3) Marissa — confirm that the customer-facing commitments (public SLA language) map to the owners' measures.

Thanks —
Kimberly

Kimberly —

Thanks. I started a short owner worksheet (Owner-Roadmap.gdoc) and a one-line template for confirmations. Early notes below; will collect owner replies into a single canonical table by EOD 6/14.

Preliminary items:
- Owner: Model Serving (Marissa) — Metric: median token latency for 95% of requests. Risk: streaming edge cases when quantized models served.
- Owner: Infra Throughput (Vivek) — Metric: sustained QPS at 99% availability. Risk: burst buffer sizing on dedicated pools.
- Owner: API Experience (Laura) — Metric: error rate on streaming responses. Risk: downstream retry behavior.

Ask for owners (what I'll solicit in the sheet):
- Confirm commit (Y/N)
- Source of truth (dashboard/metric path)
- Evidence artifacts for audit (logs/location)
- Mitigation plan for residual risk

I linked the owner sheet here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cOKRpacket and attached the Owner-Roadmap.gdoc (stub) to this message.

I'll ping owners directly tomorrow and drop a summary here.

Regards,
Rishi

Rishi / Kim —

Thanks for pulling this together. Two quick clarifications before I finalize the narrative:

1) QBR narrative: I propose the arc be (a) customer outcomes we drove last quarter, (b) what we commit to this quarter (owners + measurable), (c) top 3 risks and mitigations (audit-ready). Please confirm.
2) Audit evidence: can owners point to exact dashboards (Grafana panel id) or S3 paths for logs? KJ Consulting will want file-level retention details.

Also: we should avoid shipping any metric name changes inside the packet; instead note a measurement refresh that will be phased in for Q4 to avoid downstream confusion.

If everyone is aligned I'll weave a 2-slide narrative and share a draft for quick review tomorrow.

Folks —

Consolidated owner confirmations below (pulled from Owner-Roadmap.gdoc). I've attached the combined packet we're ready to share with Acme for transparency and with KJ Consulting for pre-audit review.

- Model Serving (Marissa) — Commit: Y. Metric: median token latency (95th). Dashboard: Grafana panel srv.latency.v2 (dash-44). Evidence: KV cache logs in s3://redwood-prod/serving/latency/2028/Q2/; retention: 180 days. Mitigation: fallback variant and increased batching on spikes.
- Infra Throughput (Vivek) — Commit: Y. Metric: sustained QPS at 99% available. Dashboard: infra.qps.clusterA; evidence: cluster metrics in prometheus -> long-term archival at s3://redwood-metrics/clusterA/; retention: 365 days.
- API Experience (Laura) — Commit: Y (with note). Metric: streaming error rate; we will keep current naming for Q3 and plan the metric rename in Q4. Dashboard: api.stream.errors panel (dash-17); evidence: request logs in ELK and archived indices in s3://redwood-logs/requests/.

Attachments: consolidated_packet_Q3_v1.zip (contains OKR slides + audit checklist + owner confirmations)

Action: Kimberly — please confirm if the packet should be shared with Acme procurement now (we've CC'd them per procurement's request) or after exec slide pack is locked.

Marissa Cole
Head of Model Ops (Interim)
Redwood Inference
